rules: Keep existing public URLs and anchors.
One business feature owns its content, presentation and artwork.
Shared presentation must not import feature-owned business content.
Keep tools/reference-release.json and build/package/verify entry points in place.
Preserve original image pixels, logo payloads, CSS order and loading behavior.
Source path allowlists must be updated in the same review as moved paths.
Protected legal/reference changes need explicit path/receipt review.
No new backend, API runtime, database or local authentication.
Keep exact vendor Welcome URL and no-referrer behavior.
